compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Computes weighted attribution accuracy (configurable weights) and enforces ≥0.7

## Implementation Notes
Current state: weights parameter accepted but never used; no config read.

Fix:
1. In visual_eval_gates.compute_weighted_accuracy, apply weights per-class to the accuracy calculation. Since DDs operate on attribution_class (categorical, not 5 score dimensions), reinterpret weights as per-attribution-class weights: weights = {implementation_drift: 0.25, design_flaw: 0.25, mixed: 0.25, uncertain: 0.25} (default equal). Per-class accuracy weighted by these weights gives a configurable importance per class.

2. In visual_eval_gates.run_all_gates, read weights from dso-config.conf:
   ```python
   import subprocess
   def _read_weights() -> list[float]:
       try:
           out = subprocess.run([".claude/scripts/dso","read-config","visual_evaluator.dimension_weights"], capture_output=True, text=True)
           if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():
               return [float(x) for x in out.stdout.strip().strip('[]').split(',')]
       except Exception:
           pass
       return DEFAULT_WEIGHTS
   ```
3. Add a new test test_weights_change_accuracy: feed corpus with imbalanced class accuracy, verify that different weights produce different weighted accuracy values.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] compute_weighted_accuracy applies weights variable in body (not just accept-and-discard)
  Verify: python3 -c "import ast; src=open('plugins/dso/scripts/visual_eval_gates.py').read(); tree=ast.parse(src); funcs=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='compute_weighted_accuracy']; assert funcs; body=ast.unparse(funcs[0]); assert body.count('weights')>=3"
- [ ] Test test_weights_change_accuracy demonstrates configurability
  Verify: grep -q 'test_weights_change_accuracy' tests/visual_eval/test_visual_eval_gates.py
- [ ] _read_weights or equivalent config-read function exists
  Verify: grep -E 'read-config|dimension_weights' plugins/dso/scripts/visual_eval_gates.py
